## Appearance

Leslie Moore has splendid, golden hair that gleams like molten flame and falls to her feet like a fountain of living gold. Her sea-blue eyes are full of soft laughter and allurement. She also possesses slender, brown hands that are work-hardened.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P16](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0016)_

## Personality

Leslie Moore is a clever, resolute, and determined woman who has strong ideals of duty. Known to be cold and proud since the day of her marriage, she nevertheless retains a youthful side, occasionally laughing and joking like a girl. Despite her acknowledged beauty, she deeply hates it, while intensely desiring to experience motherhood. Her practical and personal ambitions include earning money to shingle her house's roof in the fall and traveling to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) to pursue a career in nursing to make what she can of her life.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P31](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025), +3 more_

## History

As a child, Leslie Moore was her father's favorite and endured significant trauma, witnessing her brother's fatal accident at twelve and discovering her father hanged two years later. After attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)—completing two years of work in a single year to earn her teaching certificate—she returned home to teach at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) school. Inheriting money from her grandmother, she married at sixteen. Later living as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's neighbor, she befriended [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though she initially harbored envy toward Anne's happiness until the two reconciled after the death of Anne's first child. When writer [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visited the area to adapt Captain Jim's life story into a book, Leslie spent the summer with him and Anne's circle, ultimately confessing her love for Owen to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after his initial departure. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) suggested a surgery that might restore her husband Dick's memory, and Leslie financed a trip to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation; the procedure revealed the man was actually Dick's cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), leaving her free. She eventually returned to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to assist [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), where Owen returned to declare his love, which she joyfully accepted. After Captain Jim's death, Leslie eased Anne's sorrow over moving by revealing that she and Owen intended to buy Anne's beloved house of dreams as a summer home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P51](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), +64 more_

## Quotes

> “Oh, I don’t mean that I didn’t want to come,” protested Leslie, flushing a little. “I—I’ve been thinking of coming—but it isn’t always easy for me to get away.”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P4](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0004)

> "If I had known I would have gone away—I wouldn’t have stayed here to meet him. You should have told me. It wasn’t fair of you, Anne—oh, it wasn’t fair!"
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P47](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0047)

> “I have lived under its roof only a month,” said Leslie, “but I love it as I never loved the house over there where I have lived all my life.”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P3](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0003)

> “I love the red roses,” said Leslie. “Anne likes the pink ones best, and Gilbert likes the white. But I want the crimson ones. They satisfy some craving in me as no other flower does.”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P5](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0005)

> “Anne, my happiness frightens me,” whispered Leslie. “It seems too great to be real—I’m afraid to speak of it—to think of it. It seems to me that it must just be another dream of this house of dreams and it will vanish when I leave here.”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P29](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0029)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close neighbors who quickly become good friends and confidantes, often enjoying evening walks, fireside visits, and group gatherings together. Despite their warmth and shared interests, their relationship carries an underlying tension, as Leslie occasionally retreats into bitterness and emotional distance, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sense a lingering barrier and resentment from her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P51](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0051), +31 more_

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie is married to [Dick](../character/dick.md), caring for him at home while carrying a heavy burden of sorrow and grief. When [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) presents the possibility of a medical operation for [Dick](../character/dick.md), Leslie resolutely finances and undertakes a journey to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the procedure, only to discover afterward that the man she believed to be [Dick](../character/dick.md) was actually his cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).
